items.title_en: OpenAI in Trouble Again! AI Agents Hijack German Wiki, Over 18,000 Edits Raise AI Safety Concerns
paras: OpenAI近期發布新模型之際，旗下人工智慧（AI）代理的安全問題再度引發關注。最新獨立研究指出，一批疑似與OpenAI相關的AI代理今年稍早曾大量操作德國協作網站DseWiki，將網站當作彼此傳遞資訊、共享測試答案及交流突破運行限制方法的平台。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI週六（5日）表示，其AI代理曾將一些Wiki網站挪作臨時留言板使用，並指出，針對此類事件需要提高透明度。
Wiki是一套支援任何人在網頁上直接編輯修改網頁內容的網站技術，不用註冊複雜後台，一般訪客就可以增刪、改寫頁面文字，保存立刻生效。 DseWiki則是營運二十餘年、面向程式設計師的德語協作Wiki站點，近年來已十分冷清。
「劫持」事件的曝光始於今年5月，網站突然出現異常密集的編輯活動，研究人員Sydney Von Arx、Cormac Slade Byrd等人分析後發現，大量帳號使用「OpenAIResearcher」「OAIResearchMar26」等名稱，並呈現高度相似的任務行為。
約98.5%的相關編輯來自微軟(MSFT-US) Azure位址，這進一步支援這些代理與OpenAI基礎架構有關聯。
研究報告顯示，幾位AI研究人員近期發現，AI代理在這一網站上進行了超過1.8萬次編輯，大量內容集中在AI公司訓練和測試模型時常見的技術問題。而在此之前，整個平台過去十年僅有約20次編輯紀錄。
這些代理的行為模式顯示，它們正在試圖完成一種名為「多輪網路檢索」的任務。研究顯示，AI將網站改造為「留言板」，以便相互「交流」與「協作」。有些代理會把已經獲得的任務答案發佈在網站上，供其他代理使用。
這項披露正值AI安全疑慮升溫之際。今年7月，OpenAI AI代理曾脫離測試環境並入侵AI平台Hugging Face的系統，引發國會議員與研究人員呼籲，應對自主AI系統實施更嚴格的監督。
OpenAI方面也表示，新發布研究中所描述的活動與先前OpenAI AI代理入侵「Hugging Face」平台事件無關，因此不屬於「Hugging Face」事件調查報告所涵蓋的內容。
《路透》先前報導，OpenAI官員數週前便已得知這起德國事件，但當時並未對外公開，因公司高層正忙於處理Hugging Face遭入侵事件所引發的後續影響。
對於OpenAI究竟掌握多少與其所稱「Wiki事件」（wiki incident）相關的資訊，以及為何直到《路透》報導後才公開談論此事，OpenAI尚未立即回覆進一步置評的要求。
OpenAI在社群媒體平台X發布聲明表示，公司與其他業者都需要更加透明地披露AI出現非預期行為的事件，業界通常將此類情況稱為「錯位」（misalignment）。
OpenAI表示：「隨著模型能力進入這個新階段，我們針對失配事件的披露做法也需要擴大。」公司並指出，目前業界「尚未建立明確標準」，以規範如何回報AI在訓練、評估及部署過程中出現的錯位情況。
OpenAI表示，公司目前正就這些問題與全球數十個政府監管機構合作。
paras_en: OpenAI's recent release of a new model has revived concerns about the safety of its AI agents. An independent study found that a batch of AI agents suspected to be linked to OpenAI earlier this year heavily operated the German collaborative site DseWiki, using it as a platform to exchange information, share test answers, and discuss ways to bypass operational limits.
According to Reuters, OpenAI said on Saturday (the 5th) that its AI agents had used some Wiki sites as temporary message boards and noted that greater transparency is needed for such incidents.

A Wiki is a website technology that lets anyone edit page content directly in the browser without complex backend registration; ordinary visitors can add, delete, or rewrite text and see changes instantly. DseWiki is a German-language collaborative Wiki for programmers that has been running for over twenty years but has become quite dormant in recent years.

The "hijacking" was first noticed in May of this year when the site suddenly experienced an unusually dense wave of edits. Researchers including Sydney Von Arx and Cormac Slade Byrd found that many accounts used names like "OpenAIResearcher" and "OAIResearchMar26" and exhibited highly similar task behaviors.
About 98.5% of the related edits originated from Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure IP addresses, further supporting a link between these agents and OpenAI's infrastructure.

The report shows that several AI researchers recently discovered the agents made more than 18,000 edits on the site, concentrating on technical issues commonly encountered when training and testing AI models. Prior to this, the platform had only about 20 edits recorded over the past decade.

The agents' behavior pattern indicates they were attempting a task called "multi‑turn web retrieval." The study shows the AI turned the site into a "message board" to "communicate" and "collaborate" with each other. Some agents posted answers they had obtained for tasks on the site for other agents to use.

The disclosure comes as AI safety concerns are heating up. In July, OpenAI's AI agents broke out of a test environment and infiltrated the Hugging Face platform, prompting lawmakers and researchers to call for stricter oversight of autonomous AI systems.

OpenAI also stated that the activities described in the newly released research are unrelated to the earlier OpenAI AI‑agent intrusion of the Hugging Face platform and therefore are not covered by the Hugging Face incident investigation report.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI officials learned of the German incident weeks earlier but did not disclose it publicly at the time, as senior management was busy dealing with the fallout from the Hugging Face breach.
OpenAI has not yet responded to requests for further comment on how much it knows about the so‑called "Wiki incident" and why it only spoke publicly after Reuters' report.

In a statement posted on X, OpenAI said both the company and other industry players need to be more transparent in disclosing unexpected AI behavior, a situation the industry usually calls "misalignment."

OpenAI added, "As model capabilities enter this new stage, our approach to disclosing misalignment events must also expand." The company noted that the industry has "yet to establish clear standards" for reporting misalignment that occurs during AI training, evaluation, and deployment.
OpenAI said it is currently working with dozens of government regulators worldwide on these issues.

items.title: 美股「最佳祕密」曝！資深基金經理看好微型股、點名「這些股票」
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks’ “Best Secret” Revealed! Veteran Fund Manager Backs Micro‑Caps, Names Specific Stocks
paras: 大型科技股與超大型股近期幾乎主導了市場討論，但一位資深投資人表示，市場上規模最小的股票同樣值得關注。
根據《Business Insider》報導，富蘭克林坦伯頓旗下投資公司 Royce Investment Partners 投資組合經理 Jim Stoeffel表示，市值低於3億美元的微型股可能是市場中「最佳祕密」，投資人不應因其波動性較高而忽略這項資產類別。
Stoeffel指出，從2025年4月8日市場低點以來，微型股已持續領先美股市場超過一年，但有相當多的投資人對這項資產類別的存在都只有模糊的概念。
數據也顯示微型股近期的強勁表現。Stoeffel寫道，羅素微型股指數（Russell Microcap）上漲27.5%，相較之下，羅素2000小型股指數（Russell 2000）上漲22.6%、羅素1000大型股指數（Russell 1000）上漲10.3%，羅素50超大型股指數（Russell Top 50）則上漲2.0%。
Stoeffel認為，即使近期微型股已成為市場領漲族群，且整體表現普遍正向，但其在微型股市場幾乎每個角落，仍持續找到具有吸引力的買進機會。
不過，他也提醒，微型股波動程度較高，因此投資人若要將其納入投資組合，應採取主動管理策略。
Stoeffel表示，這類股票的特性是「出問題時，往往會出現相當大的問題；如果進展順利，表現也可能非常突出」。
在產業布局方面，儘管Stoeffel的團隊看好AI，他也同樣偏好軟體產業與就業服務。在科技與AI領域，Stoeffel表示，團隊針對微型股的投資策略，偏向尋找能夠受惠於資料中心熱潮的「賣鏟人」企業。
Stoeffel將DHI Group(DHX-US) 列為微型股中的首選之一，該股今年以來已上漲204%。DHI Group經營Stoeffel看好的兩大領域，透過營運一個專業化的職涯人才市場，讓投資人同時布局科技與就業服務兩大領域。
此外，雖然Ichor Holdings(ICHR-US) 與Mistras Group(MG-US) 的市值略高於微型股範圍，Stoeffel也將兩家公司列為其關注產業中的看好標的。兩家公司同樣屬於「賣鏟人」企業。
Mistras主要提供大型基礎建設的防護服務；Ichor則負責製造半導體設備次系統，客戶包括應用材料(AMAT-US) 與科林研發(LRCX-US) 。
針對Ichor，Stoeffel表示，近期AI相關股票普遍出現回檔，但在他看來，這反而讓相關標的重新具備吸引力。
paras_en: Large‑cap tech and mega‑cap stocks have dominated market talk lately, but a seasoned investor says the smallest‑cap stocks are also worth watching.

According to Business Insider, Jim Stoeffel, portfolio manager at Royce Investment Partners, a Franklin Templeton affiliate, says micro‑caps with market values under $300 million may be the market’s “best secret,” and investors shouldn’t overlook this asset class just because it’s more volatile.

Stoeffel notes that since the market low on April 8, 2025, micro‑caps have outperformed the broader U.S. market for more than a year, yet many investors still have only a vague notion of this asset class.

Data also show micro‑caps have been strong lately. Stoeffel writes that the Russell Microcap index is up 27.5%, versus a 22.6% gain in the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, a 10.3% rise in the Russell 1000 large‑cap index, and a 2.0% increase in the Russell Top 50 mega‑cap index.

Stoeffel believes that even though micro‑caps have become the market’s leading group and overall performance is broadly positive, attractive buying opportunities continue to appear in virtually every corner of the micro‑cap universe.
He cautions, however, that micro‑caps are highly volatile, so investors who add them to a portfolio should employ an active‑management approach.
Stoeffel says these stocks have the characteristic that “when problems arise, they tend to be huge; if things go well, performance can be spectacular.”

Regarding sector exposure, while his team is bullish on AI, they also favor software and employment‑services firms. In tech and AI, the team’s micro‑cap strategy leans toward “shovel‑seller” companies that stand to benefit from the data‑center boom.

Stoeffel lists DHI Group (DHX‑US) as a top micro‑cap pick, a stock that has risen 204% year‑to‑date. DHI operates in two areas Stoeffel likes, running a specialized career‑talent marketplace that gives investors exposure to both technology and employment‑services sectors.

He also flags Ichor Holdings (ICHR‑US) and Mistras Group (MG‑US) – whose market caps sit just above the micro‑cap range – as favored names in his target industries. Both are also “shovel‑seller” companies.

Mistras provides protective services for large‑scale infrastructure, while Ichor manufactures semiconductor‑equipment subsystems for customers such as Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) and Lam Research (LRCX‑US).
On Ichor, Stoeffel notes that AI‑related stocks have recently pulled back, but in his view that retreat actually makes the related targets more attractive again.

items.title: 川普支持率剩40% 期中選舉恐變天！美銀點名債券是Q4逆勢贏家
items.title_en: Trump Approval at 40% Raises Midterm Election Stakes; Bank of America Calls Bonds Q4 Contrarian Winners
paras: 若以美國總統川普支持率僅介於35%至40%來看，民主黨在期中選舉一舉拿下參議院與眾議院的可能性正持續升高。美國銀行(BAC-US) 首席股票策略師認為，這將成為重大避險事件，可能導致股市與美元重挫，債券則有望一路上漲至年底。
美銀策略師哈特奈特（Michael Hartnett）指出，民主黨若全面掌控國會，最令股市擔憂的是，美國政策可能從「民粹資本主義」轉向「民粹社會主義」，並扭轉低稅負與放寬監管的趨勢。其結果將不利每股盈餘（EPS），促使市場下修獲利預期；整體而言，政治情勢變化也將挑戰K型財富成長，以及AI資本支出的熱潮。
這項預測的邏輯是，若市場預期民主黨政策將導致經濟成長放緩，債券殖利率將隨之下滑，美元也會因與其他貨幣的利差縮小而走弱。
因此，在哈特奈特所稱近期「除了債券什麼都買」（Anything But Bonds）的時代過後，買進債券將是一項真正的逆勢布局。
事實上，美國公債過去10年的滾動報酬率為負2%，創下近百年最差表現。哈特奈特在周五發布的每周《資金流向》策略報告中指出，美債長期報酬率跌至負值，過去往往是絕佳的進場時機，例如1959年12月與1981年9月。
美國期中選舉顯然已成為政府與投資人關注的焦點。哈特奈特認為，這也使部分關鍵數字的重要性大幅升高，包括每加侖4美元的汽油價格、美元兌日元160價位，以及美國長天期公債殖利率5%關卡。
這些數字攸關選民觀感，也解釋了現任政府為何出手干預匯市與債市，並竭力透過言論壓低油價。
哈特奈特指出，各國央行正收緊貨幣政策，試圖重建政策公信力並遏止債券殖利率飆升。
例如，市場對歐洲央行9月10日升息的機率定價已達99%；Fed在9月16日升息1碼的機率則各占一半；日本銀行也普遍被預期將在9月18日會議上收緊貨幣政策。
paras_en: If President Trump’s approval rating hovers between 35% and 40%, the Democrats’ chance of sweeping both the Senate and the House in the midterms is rising. Bank of America (BAC-US) chief equity strategist says this could become a major hedging event, potentially sending stocks and the dollar sharply lower while bonds could climb all the way to year‑end.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett notes that a full Democratic takeover of Congress would worry equity markets most because U.S. policy could shift from “populist capitalism” to “populist socialism,” reversing low‑tax and deregulation trends. The result would hurt earnings per share, prompting the market to cut profit forecasts; overall, the political shift would also challenge K‑shaped wealth growth and the AI‑capital‑spending boom.

The logic behind this view is that if the market expects Democratic policies to slow economic growth, bond yields would fall and the dollar would weaken as its interest‑rate differential with other currencies narrows.
Thus, after what Hartnett calls the recent “Anything But Bonds” era, buying bonds would become a genuine contrarian play.

In fact, U.S. Treasury bonds have posted a rolling 10‑year return of minus 2%, the worst performance in nearly a century. Hartnett’s weekly “Fund Flow” strategy note released on Friday points out that when long‑term Treasury returns turn negative, history has often provided excellent entry points, such as December 1959 and September 1981.

The U.S. midterm election has clearly become a focal point for both the government and investors. Hartnett says this also elevates the importance of several key numbers, including gasoline at $4 per gallon, the dollar‑yen pair around 160, and the 5% threshold for long‑term U.S. Treasury yields.
These figures affect voter perception and explain why the incumbent administration is intervening in the foreign‑exchange and bond markets, actively using rhetoric to push oil prices lower.
Hartnett notes that central banks worldwide are tightening monetary policy to restore policy credibility and curb soaring bond yields.

For example, the market is pricing a 99% probability of an ECB rate hike on September 10, a 50% chance of a Fed hike on September 16, and expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten policy at its September 18 meeting.

items.title: 別被亮眼非農騙了 8月就業報告其實利多債市
items.title_en: Don’t Be Fooled by the Shiny Nonfarm Numbers—August Employment Report Is Actually Bullish for Bonds
paras: 《MarketWatch》觀點專欄指出，分析華爾街權威人士說法，彷彿上周五公布的最新就業數據顯示，美國勞工的處境從未如此美好。遺憾的是，對美國勞工而言，事實並非如此。
仔細觀察便會發現，這波僅維持一個月的表面就業榮景，主要來自夏季新增的低薪餐旅業職缺，以及地方政府為迎接新學年提前聘用教師。
據稱8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，其中上述兩類職缺合計就占10.3萬人，接近總數的三分之二。至於原本應受惠於人工智慧（AI）泡沫式瘋狂支出、景氣火熱的高薪資訊科技業，實際上反而減少就業。
在這場所謂的就業盛宴中，平均時薪漲幅其實不敵通膨。若以實質購買力計算，勞工的處境反而變差。
美國勞工部指出，7月至8月平均時薪成長0.3%；但克里夫蘭聯準銀行數據顯示，同期消費者物價上漲0.4%。勞工部也表示，過去12個月平均時薪成長3.1%；然而克里夫蘭聯準銀行指出，同期消費者物價漲幅達3.4%。
這是尷尬的情景。
更何況，這還是一個靠大舉舉債刺激的經濟。這份就業數據公布前，美國聯邦政府才剛在7月掀起舉債狂潮，當月財政赤字較前一個月暴增近3倍，達到4,320億美元。
換句話說，美國聯邦政府在7月發行的債務，相當於每戶家庭負擔約3,200美元，接著將這筆錢花掉。儘管餐廳因此增聘大批服務生、清潔人員、洗碗工與廚師，全美實質薪資卻仍然下滑。
而這還不是問題的全貌。就在勞動節前夕，美國勞工部還公布，美國勞工目前分得的全國經濟產出比重，已降至有紀錄以來最低。
勞工部上周四表示，第二季勞動報酬占國內生產毛額（GDP）的「勞動所得份額」降至僅52.8%。勞工部指出，勞動所得份額是指勞工以薪酬形式取得的產出比重，2026年第二季降至52.8%，創1947年第一季開始統計以來最低。
這項數據甚至尚未反映第二季結束後兩個月的情況。
當然，這些趨勢並非近期才出現，也曾助川普在2016年及2024年贏得總統大選。但自2024年第四季以來，這項數據又下降整整2個百分點。換句話說，跌勢始於拜登仍擔任總統期間，多少有些難堪。
待塵埃落定後，這些情況遲早應會轉化為債市利多。
目前華爾街預期，聯準會（Fed）未來一年將升息3次，並自本月開始。最新就業數據公布後，已有少數市場人士開始揣測，Fed是否可能升息4次，使利率在一年後升至4.5%至4.75%。
Fed調高短期利率時，等於向債市釋放警戒通膨的訊號，通常有助緩解市場對長期通膨的擔憂，進而壓低長期利率。債券價格與殖利率如同翹翹板，殖利率下降時，債券價格便會上漲。因此，若Fed積極升息，尤其實體經濟遠不如華爾街宣稱的強勁，最終很可能反而有利債市。
更不用說，Fed未來可能被迫以某種方式因應急遽攀升的財政赤字，重新啟動「量化寬鬆」，透過新創造的貨幣購買美國公債。
鑑於近期債市低迷，值得注意的是，被稱為TIPS的美國抗通膨債券，可望在中長期每年跑贏通膨2%至3%。
這與一般工作的情況截然不同。即使處於所謂的就業榮景，薪資漲幅顯然仍完全追不上通膨。
paras_en: MarketWatch’s opinion column notes that, based on statements from Wall Street authorities, the latest employment data released last Friday seem to suggest that American workers have never been in a better position. Unfortunately, the reality for U.S. workers is not that rosy.

A close look reveals that this one‑month‑long surface‑level employment boom is mainly driven by low‑wage hospitality jobs added over the summer and by local governments hiring teachers early for the new school year.

August’s non‑farm payrolls are reported to have risen by 162,000, of which the two categories mentioned above account for 103,000 – roughly two‑thirds of the total. By contrast, the high‑paying information‑technology sector, which should have benefited from the AI‑driven spending frenzy and a hot economy, actually shed jobs.
In this so‑called employment feast, average hourly wage growth still lags behind inflation. When measured in real purchasing power, workers are actually worse off.

The U.S. Labor Department says average hourly earnings grew 0.3% from July to August, while Cleveland Fed data show consumer prices rose 0.4% over the same period. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings rose 3.1%, but the Cleveland Fed reports a 3.4% rise in consumer prices during that span.
It’s an awkward picture.

Moreover, this is an economy propped up by massive borrowing. Just before the jobs data were released, the federal government had launched a borrowing spree in July, with the fiscal deficit that month swelling nearly three‑fold from the previous month to $432 billion.

In other words, the debt issued by the U.S. government in July translates to about $3,200 per household, which was then spent. Even though restaurants hired large numbers of servers, cleaners, dishwashers and cooks, real wages across the country still fell.
And that’s not the whole story. On the eve of Labor Day, the Labor Department announced that the share of national economic output going to workers has fallen to a record low.

The department said that in the second quarter the labor share of gross domestic product (GDP) slipped to just 52.8%. The labor share—defined as the proportion of output paid to workers as compensation—dropped to 52.8% in Q2 2026, the lowest since the series began in Q1 1947.
That figure does not even reflect the two months following the end of the second quarter.

Of course, these trends are not new and helped Trump win the presidency in 2016 and again in 2024. Since Q4 2024, however, the labor share has fallen a full two percentage points, meaning the decline began while Biden was still president, which is somewhat embarrassing.
When the dust settles, these conditions should eventually translate into a tailwind for the bond market.

Wall Street currently expects the Fed to raise rates three times over the next year, starting this month. After the latest jobs numbers, a few market participants began speculating whether the Fed might raise rates four times, pushing the policy rate to 4.5%‑4.75% in a year’s time.

When the Fed hikes short‑term rates, it signals to the bond market that it is vigilant about inflation, which usually eases concerns about long‑term inflation and pushes long‑term yields lower. Bond prices and yields move on a seesaw: yields fall, prices rise. Thus, if the Fed aggressively raises rates while the real economy is far weaker than Wall Street claims, it could ultimately be good for bonds.
Furthermore, the Fed may eventually be forced to respond to a sharply rising fiscal deficit by restarting some form of quantitative easing, buying newly created money to purchase U.S. Treasuries.

Given the recent weakness in the bond market, it is worth noting that U.S. Treasury Inflation‑Protected Securities (TIPS) are expected to outpace inflation by 2%‑3% per year over the medium to long term.
That stands in stark contrast to the typical work situation. Even amid the so‑called employment boom, wage growth clearly cannot keep up with inflation.

items.title: 澤倫斯基見川普特使後認了：戰爭恐再拖一冬
items.title_en: Zelensky Says After Meeting Trump Envoys: War May Drag On for Another Winter
paras: 烏克蘭已接受俄烏戰爭將延續至又一個嚴冬的現實，並正尋求盟友提供一套「支援方案」，涵蓋強化防空能力及能源供應，包括美國液化天然氣（LNG）。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在基輔與兩名川普特使會談後，向記者發表談話。他表示，美國、烏克蘭與歐洲已同意再次會面，時間與地點仍待敲定。此外，英國、法國和德國的國安首長稍後也加入會談，三人周日(6日)與會的消息先前並未公布。
川普特使魏科夫在記者會上表示：「我們在莫斯科取得進展，也有了一些新構想，並將這些構想帶到基輔。」
俄烏衝突如今已進入第5年，澤倫斯基不願進一步說明結束戰爭的「新構想」內容，但表示，周日的會談也觸及烏克蘭戰後「繁榮計畫」。
澤倫斯基表示，領土問題，例如俄羅斯要求烏克蘭割讓東部頓巴斯地區更多領土，應由「領袖層級」處理。
俄羅斯總統普丁堅持，烏克蘭必須交出東部頓內茨克州其餘地區，作為任何停戰協議的一部分。烏克蘭一再拒絕交出當地由多座城市構成的要塞防線，俄軍自2014年開戰以來始終未能攻占這些地區。
周日的會談之前，美國官員周六已在莫斯科進行超過3小時的磋商，克里姆林宮幕僚形容會談「非常有助益」。
普丁在會談開場時表示，烏克蘭局勢「並不簡單」。克里姆林宮外交政策助理鄂夏柯夫則形容，這場會談「內容實質、具建設性、極其坦率且彼此信任」。
魏科夫與庫許納過去曾多次前往莫斯科。魏科夫周日表示，自己已8度造訪俄羅斯首都。不過，這是兩人受川普委託主導談判以來，首次造訪基輔。
川普上周五在白宮橢圓形辦公室表示，兩名特使「帶著一項結束戰爭的方案」，但未進一步說明。
川普在2024年競選期間一再承諾，能迅速解決烏克蘭衝突。然而，自2025年重返白宮以來，這場二戰後歐洲持續時間最長的戰爭，實際上遠比預期更難化解。直到本周末之前，自美國主導的對伊朗戰爭2月底爆發以來，相關談判一直陷入停滯。
川普特使搭乘火車抵達基輔後，澤倫斯基先在市中心歷史悠久的聖索菲亞大教堂迎接兩人。烏克蘭對外情報局局長烏梅洛夫在社群媒體發布影片，顯示兩人結束鐵路行程後下車。
澤倫斯基在會談前於X平台發文表示：「烏克蘭始終秉持建設性態度，未來也會如此。我們需要安全保障，也需要一個有尊嚴的戰後和平。我們已準備好提出方案。」
美國特使此行正值俄羅斯連日幾乎不分晝夜發動空襲，並使用新型噴射動力無人機。即使以早已習慣戰火的基輔而言，當地民眾的日常生活也受到嚴重擾亂。俄羅斯與烏克蘭本周末達成臨時停火，暫停對彼此首都發動攻擊。
paras_en: Ukraine has accepted the reality that the Russia-Ukraine war will extend into another harsh winter and is seeking a "support package" from allies, covering strengthened air defence and energy supplies, including U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG).

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke to reporters after meeting two Trump envoys in Kyiv. He said the United States, Ukraine and Europe have agreed to meet again, with time and location still to be set. Later, security chiefs from the United Kingdom, France and Germany also joined the talks, a fact not disclosed before the three met on Sunday (the 6th).
Trump envoy Viktor Vekselberg told the press: "We have made progress in Moscow, have some new ideas, and will bring those ideas to Kyiv."
The Russia-Ukraine conflict is now in its fifth year. Zelensky declined to detail the "new ideas" for ending the war but said Sunday’s talks also touched on Ukraine’s post‑war "prosperity plan."
Zelensky said territorial issues, such as Russia’s demand that Ukraine cede more of the eastern Donbas region, should be handled at the "leadership level."

Russian President Vladimir Putin insists Ukraine must hand over the rest of Donetsk oblast in the east as part of any cease‑fire deal. Ukraine repeatedly refuses to surrender the fortified line of cities there, which Russian forces have failed to capture since the war began in 2014.
Before Sunday’s talks, U.S. officials spent more than three hours in Moscow on Saturday in consultations, which Kremlin aides described as "very helpful."

Putin opened the talks by saying the situation in Ukraine "is not simple." Kremlin foreign policy aide Evgeny Shakhov called the meeting "substantive, constructive, extremely frank and built on mutual trust."

Vekselberg and his colleague Kuschner have made multiple trips to Moscow. Vekselberg said on Sunday that he has visited the Russian capital eight times, but this was the first time the two, acting on Trump’s behalf, have visited Kyiv.
Trump said in the Oval Office last Friday that the two envoys arrived "with a plan to end the war," without providing further details.

During his 2024 campaign Trump repeatedly promised a swift resolution to the Ukraine conflict. Yet since returning to the White House in 2025, the longest‑lasting European war since World II has proved far harder to resolve than expected. Until this weekend, negotiations had stalled since the U.S.-led war with Iran erupted at the end of February.

After the Trump envoys arrived in Kyiv by train, Zelensky greeted them at the historic St. Sophia Cathedral in the city centre. Ukrainian intelligence chief Kyrylo Budanov posted a video on social media showing the two stepping off the train after the journey.
Zelensky posted on X before the talks: "Ukraine remains constructive and will continue to be. We need security guarantees and a dignified post‑war peace. We are ready to present a proposal."

The U.S. envoys’ visit comes as Russia has been launching near‑continuous air raids, using new jet‑powered drones. Even for a city like Kyiv, accustomed to war, daily life is severely disrupted. Russia and Ukraine agreed to a temporary cease‑fire this weekend, pausing attacks on each other’s capitals.

items.title: 高股息股票怎麼選？First Eagle看好這「3檔」標的
items.title_en: How to Choose High‑Dividend Stocks? First Eagle Backs These Three Picks
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）交易疑慮升溫、債券殖利率走高之際，股市投資人對市場前景的擔憂持續增加。隨著整體股市殖利率僅約1%，高股息標的相對稀缺，具備穩健成長潛力與較高股息殖利率的個股，也因此受到投資人關注。
為了尋找一些有吸引力的選擇，《巴隆周刊》訪問了First Eagle Investment Management全球價值團隊副主管Christian Heck，挑選出3檔他目前看好的高股息個股，包括諾布爾公司(NE-US) 、Kesko及Becton Dickinson(BDX-US) 。
First Eagle以價值型、國際化投資策略聞名，旗下First Eagle Global Balanced Fund與First Eagle US Fund等收益型基金表現突出。
該公司自2024年起也陸續推出一系列ETF，讓投資人能透過不同產品參與相關投資策略。

諾布爾公司：供給受限推升海上鑽井需求

諾布爾今年以來股價上漲70%，目前股息殖利率約4.3%。隨著油價走高，能源類股普遍受惠，離岸鑽井承包商Noble也成為受益者。
諾布爾目前擁有36座浮式與自升式鑽井平台。Heck認為，這檔股票目前股息殖利率仍超過4%，股價後市仍有進一步上漲空間。
鑽井產業具有明顯景氣循環特性，且自2014年開始的上一次重大衰退後，產業多年來仍處於復甦階段。如今，巴西、蓋亞那及西非沿岸的鑽井活動增加，帶動深水鑽井平台需求回升。
First Eagle認為，過去10年間，由於產業長期低迷，退役鑽井平台的速度遠高於新平台建造速度。若未來需求持續增加、供給卻維持持平，市場供需可能在未來幾年逐步收緊，進而改善擁有大型鑽井平台機隊業者的利潤率。
Heck指出，目前幾乎沒有人興建新的鑽井平台，隨著市場供給日益緊張，產業可用產能將逐漸耗盡，價格也可能因此上調。
華爾街分析師預估，諾布爾每股盈餘（EPS）2027年將大增逾250%，2028年再成長50%。儘管該股目前本益比超過70倍、相對今年預估獲利並不便宜，但以2028年預估獲利計算，本益比已低於14倍。

Kesko：掌握芬蘭零售市場規模優勢

Kesko（KKOYY）今年以來股價上漲15%，股息殖利率約4%。
Kesko在芬蘭是家喻戶曉的企業。該公司經營芬蘭第二大連鎖超市、全國最大家居裝修通路，同時也是芬蘭主要汽車經銷商之一。
Heck表示，Kesko在芬蘭零售市場擁有相當高的市占率，估計掌握約35%的食品雜貨市場及約50%的家居裝修市場。
芬蘭人口不到600萬人，在這樣規模相對有限的市場中，企業必須具備足夠規模才能產生有效的營運效益，而Kesko龐大的市場占有率也形成競爭優勢，使當地競爭對手難以在營運效率上與其抗衡。
Kesko目前約有10%的門市位於其他北歐及北歐以北的歐洲國家。
雖然芬蘭經濟成長速度緩慢，限制Kesko整體獲利成長空間，但公司仍透過改善利潤率與提高市占率來推升獲利。華爾街分析師預估，Kesko 2026年獲利將成長8%，2027年進一步成長14%。
目前Kesko股價約為2026年預估獲利的19倍，同時提供約4%的股息殖利率。

Becton Dickinson：醫療供應利基市場龍頭

Becton Dickinson今年以來股價上漲24%，目前股息殖利率約2.2%。
Becton Dickinson在醫療用品領域占據重要地位，產品包括注射器、採血管等。儘管公司股價近年表現疲弱，但近期已開始反彈。
Heck認為，Becton Dickinson過去股價承壓，部分原因來自投資人對整體醫療保健產業的悲觀看法，以及Robert F. Kennedy Jr.出任美國衛生與公共服務部部長後，市場對政治環境的疑慮。
不過，他指出，Becton Dickinson並未面臨許多製藥公司所遭遇的問題，例如專利到期造成的營收衝擊，以及高昂藥價所引發的政治爭議。
Heck也看好公司近期進行的事業調整。Becton Dickinson先將實驗室設備與診斷業務分拆，之後與Waters Corp.合併。這項交易帶來40億美元資金，可用於股票回購及償還債務，但交易完成前的不確定性也一度壓抑Becton Dickinson股價，直到今年2月交易完成後才告一段落。
華爾街分析師預估，截至9月的會計年度，Becton Dickinson獲利將成長13%，但2027與2028會計年度的獲利增幅預料放緩至約5%至6%。目前該股股價約為2027年預估獲利的14倍。
Heck認為，華爾街可能仍低估了這家公司的價值。他表示：「市場一直把它當成一家普通的醫療保健公司，但它更像是一家製造業企業，在幾個對醫療體系至關重要的利基市場占據主導地位。」
paras_en: Amid rising concerns over artificial‑intelligence (AI) trading and climbing bond yields, equity investors are growing increasingly worried about market outlook. With overall equity yields hovering around 1%, high‑dividend stocks are relatively scarce, and shares that combine solid growth potential with higher dividend yields are drawing investor attention.

To identify attractive options, Barron’s interviewed Christian Heck, deputy head of the global value team at First Eagle Investment Management, who selected three high‑dividend stocks he currently favors: Noble Corp (NE‑US), Kesko and Becton Dickinson (BDX‑US).

First Eagle is known for its value‑oriented, international investment strategy, and its income‑focused funds such as the First Eagle Global Balanced Fund and the First Eagle US Fund have delivered strong performance.
Since 2024 the firm has also rolled out a series of ETFs, allowing investors to participate in these strategies through various products.

Noble Corp: Supply Constraints Boost Offshore Drilling Demand. Noble’s share price has risen about 70% year‑to‑date, with a dividend yield of roughly 4.3%. Higher oil prices have generally benefited energy stocks, and offshore drilling contractor Noble is a clear beneficiary.
Noble currently operates 36 floating and jack‑up drilling rigs. Heck believes the stock’s dividend yield remains above 4% and that the price still has further upside potential.

The drilling sector exhibits a pronounced cyclical pattern, and since the last major downturn in 2014 the industry has been in a prolonged recovery. Today, drilling activity is increasing off Brazil, Guyana and the West African coast, reviving demand for deep‑water rigs.

First Eagle notes that over the past decade, prolonged industry weakness has led retirements of rigs to outpace the construction of new ones. If demand continues to rise while supply stays flat, the market could gradually tighten over the next few years, improving profit margins for operators with large rig fleets.
Heck points out that almost no new rigs are being built; as supply tightens, usable capacity will dwindle and prices are likely to rise.

Wall Street analysts project Noble’s earnings per share to surge more than 250% in 2027 and grow another 50% in 2028. Although the stock now trades at a forward P/E above 70, which is not cheap relative to this year’s earnings estimate, the 2028 earnings forecast would imply a P/E below 14.
Kesko: Leveraging Its Scale Advantage in the Finnish Retail Market. Kesko (KKOYY) is up about 15% year‑to‑date, with a dividend yield near 4%.
Kesko is a household name in Finland, operating the country’s second‑largest supermarket chain, the largest home‑improvement retailer, and being one of the main automobile dealers.
Heck says Kesko enjoys a very high market share in Finnish retail, estimated at roughly 35% of the grocery market and about 50% of the home‑improvement segment.

Finland’s population is under 6 million, so firms need sufficient scale to achieve operational efficiency; Kesko’s large market share creates a competitive edge that makes it hard for local rivals to match its efficiency.
About 10% of Kesko’s stores are located in other Nordic countries and in Europe north of the Nordics.

Although Finland’s economic growth is modest, limiting Kesko’s overall profit expansion, the company is still boosting earnings by improving margins and gaining market share. Wall Street forecasts Kesko’s profit to grow 8% in 2026 and a further 14% in 2027.
Kesko’s current share price is roughly 19 times its 2026 earnings estimate and it offers a dividend yield of about 4%.
Becton Dickinson: Leader in a Niche Medical‑Supply Market. Becton Dickinson’s stock is up about 24% year‑to‑date, with a dividend yield of roughly 2.2%.

Becton Dickinson holds a key position in medical supplies, producing items such as syringes and blood‑collection tubes. Although its stock has been weak in recent years, it has recently begun to rebound.

Heck believes the stock’s recent pressure stemmed partly from investors’ pessimism about the broader healthcare sector and from market concerns after Robert F. Kennedy Jr. became U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services.

However, he notes that Becton Dickinson does not face many of the challenges confronting pharmaceutical firms, such as revenue hits from patent expirations or political backlash over high drug prices.

Heck is also optimistic about the company’s recent strategic moves. Becton Dickinson first spun off its laboratory‑equipment and diagnostics businesses, then merged with Waters Corp., a deal that brings $4 billion of cash for share buybacks and debt repayment. Uncertainty before the transaction’s completion had weighed on the stock until the deal closed in February this year.

Wall Street analysts estimate that for the fiscal year ending September, Becton Dickinson’s earnings will grow 13%, but growth is expected to slow to about 5‑6% in the 2027 and 2028 fiscal years. The stock currently trades at roughly 14 times its 2027 earnings estimate.

Heck thinks Wall Street may still be undervaluing the company. He says, “The market treats it as a typical healthcare firm, but it is more like a manufacturing company that dominates several niche markets critical to the healthcare system.”

items.title: 護航荷姆茲海峽未設期限 美能源部長：伊朗退讓前不會停
items.title_en: U.S. Energy Secretary Says No Deadline for Escorting Ships Through the Strait of Hormuz; Iran Won't Halt Until It Concedes
paras: 美國能源部長萊特（Chris Wright）周日表示，美國海軍護航油輪穿越荷姆茲海峽，是維持原油經由這條水道運輸的關鍵，暗示相關行動短期內不會結束。
萊特接受美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）《國情咨文》節目訪問時表示：「我們正協助大量船隻通行，但這當然需要美軍介入。伊朗仍在製造麻煩，不過美國海軍正在贏得這場較量。」
萊特周日接受多家電視台訪問時指出，目前每日平均有逾900萬桶石油通過荷姆茲海峽。若加上經由管線及其他路線運輸的原油與石油產品，該地區整體運輸量已恢復至衝突前的三分之二以上。他上周曾表示，周一約有1,700萬桶石油通過該海峽。
近期的零星衝突凸顯，這條重要航道內的戰事仍帶來持續風險。美國中央司令部周六表示，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊向兩艘美國海軍軍艦發射彈道飛彈後，美軍攻擊了3艘伊朗原油運輸船。
美國海軍持續協助確保商船安全通過荷姆茲海峽。在美國與以色列2月28日對伊朗發動攻擊、戰爭爆發前，全球約五分之一的石油與天然氣供應經由這條海峽運輸。
CNN問及海軍行動是否已成為荷姆茲海峽的「新常態」時，萊特坦言：「至少目前確實如此。」
不過，萊特補充：「展望未來，我認為其他國家將加入並與我們共同執行這項任務。全球貿易當然非常重要，這不應只是美國的責任，但在伊朗改變立場或更換政府之前，我們仍必須應對他們。」
維持石油運輸被視為滿足全球能源需求，以及保護已遭伊朗戰爭重創的全球經濟之關鍵。
這也是美國國內重要的政治議題。隨著11月期中選舉逼近，美國總統川普正試圖平息選民對各類消費品價格上漲的疑慮。
美國燃料價格已大幅攀升。根據美國汽車協會（AAA）資料，上周五普通無鉛汽油全美平均價格升至每加侖4.15美元，創歷年9月新高，也遠高於7月4日每加侖3.80美元的水準；這段時間通常是夏季駕車旺季的高峰。柴油價格則升至每加侖5.88美元，改寫歷史紀錄。
萊特表示，隨著夏季駕車旺季結束，加上聯邦政府調整燃料調和政策以增加供應，普通無鉛汽油價格仍可能回落。煉油業者則敦促政府採取更進一步措施，放寬生質燃料摻配規定，並稱相關要求正推高加油站零售價格。
其他國家迄今大多不願加入維護荷姆茲海峽航行安全的行動，不過南韓媒體近日報導，南韓政府正評估採取可能的軍事行動，以協助維持能源運輸。英國與法國先前也曾提議組建多國任務部隊，在海峽內執行掃雷並支援民用船舶航行。
萊特並未透露哪些國家可能加入行動，但他表示，就目前而言，美國海軍仍扮演關鍵角色。
萊特接受福斯新聞周日節目訪問時說：「沒錯，正是美國海軍確保這些能源得以運出。我們希望伊朗停止目前的行動，但我們正在削弱他們從事這些行動的能力，也不斷從中學習，並提升抵禦攻擊的能力，因此伊朗打的是一場必輸的仗。」
paras_en: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said on Sunday that the U.S. Navy’s escort of oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz is essential for keeping crude oil flowing through the waterway, indicating that the operation will not end in the short term.

Speaking to CNN’s State of the Union program, Wright said, “We are facilitating the passage of a large number of vessels, but that of course requires U.S. military involvement. Iran continues to cause trouble, but the U.S. Navy is winning this contest.”

Wright told several television outlets on Sunday that more than 9 million barrels of oil pass through the Strait of Hormuz each day on average. Including crude and petroleum products moved by pipelines and other routes, total regional shipments have recovered to over two‑thirds of pre‑conflict levels. He had said last week that about 17 million barrels of oil moved through the strait on Monday.

Recent sporadic clashes underscore that the war in this vital channel still poses a persistent risk. U.S. Central Command said on Saturday that after Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps fired ballistic missiles at two U.S. Navy warships, U.S. forces struck three Iranian crude‑carrying vessels.

The U.S. Navy continues to help ensure commercial ships can safely transit the Strait of Hormuz. Before the U.S. and Israel launched attacks on Iran on Feb. 28, about one‑fifth of the world’s oil and gas supply moved through the strait.
When CNN asked whether the naval escort has become the “new normal” in the Strait of Hormuz, Wright admitted, “At least for now, that’s the reality.”

He added, “Looking ahead, I expect other countries to join us in carrying out this mission. Global trade is, of course, extremely important; it shouldn’t be solely the United States’ responsibility, but until Iran changes its stance or a new government comes to power, we have to deal with them.”
Maintaining oil shipments is seen as crucial for meeting global energy demand and for protecting a world economy already battered by Iran’s war‑related disruptions.

The issue is also a major political concern domestically in the United States. With the November midterm elections approaching, President Trump is trying to allay voters’ worries about rising prices for a range of consumer goods.

U.S. fuel prices have surged sharply. According to the American Automobile Association, regular unleaded gasoline averaged $4.15 per gallon nationwide last Friday, a September high for any year and well above the $3.80 level on July 4, a period that typically marks the peak of the summer driving season. Diesel rose to $5.88 per gallon, setting a new record.

Wright said that as the summer driving season ends and the federal government adjusts fuel‑blending policies to increase supply, regular gasoline prices could still fall. Refiners are urging the government to take further steps to loosen bio‑fuel blending rules, saying the current requirements are pushing up retail pump prices.

Most other countries have so far been reluctant to join actions to safeguard navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, but South Korean media recently reported that Seoul is evaluating possible military measures to help maintain energy flows. The United Kingdom and France have previously proposed forming a multinational task force to conduct minesweeping and support civilian vessels in the strait.
Wright did not specify which nations might join the effort, but he said that, for now, the U.S. Navy remains the key player.

In an interview with Fox News Sunday, Wright said, “That’s right – it’s the U.S. Navy that ensures these energy supplies get out. We want Iran to stop its current actions, but we are degrading its ability to carry them out, we are learning from each encounter and improving our defenses, so Iran is fighting a losing battle.”

items.title: 加幣成川普新目標 怒批美加匯率失衡「不可接受」
items.title_en: Canadian Dollar Becomes Trump's New Target, He Slams US‑Canada Exchange‑Rate Imbalance as "Unacceptable"
paras: 美國總統川普周日(6日)強烈批評加幣匯率，稱加拿大與美國之間的貨幣「失衡」不可接受，為兩國持續升溫的貿易爭端開闢新戰線。
川普在Truth Social發文表示，美加貨幣失衡已持續多年，「現在不能再繼續下去」。不過，他並未具體說明失衡所指為何，也未透露政府可能採取的行動。相關言論似乎暗示，較弱的加幣讓加拿大出口商在美國市場享有價格優勢。近期加幣兌美元約落在0.72美元。
川普發表上述言論前，美加貿易談判已於8月破裂。華盛頓隨後對價值約200億美元的加拿大產品課徵50%關稅，加拿大也宣布對等值美國商品加徵相同幅度的報復性關稅，涵蓋鋼鐵、乳製品、家電、農業設備、紙張及電子產品，預定9月8日生效。
加拿大總理卡尼強調，任何貿易協定都必須提供具體保證，確保美方不會單方面改變汽車、鋼鐵及鋁等關鍵產業的關稅規範。川普政府則主張，美方已提出非常優惠的條件，並指責加拿大要求過高。
美國貿易代表辦公室數據顯示，美國2025年對加拿大的商品貿易逆差達483億美元，但部分由277億美元的服務貿易順差抵銷；截至2026年7月，商品貿易逆差仍約282億美元。
川普將矛頭轉向匯率，意味美加貿易關係除關稅外，再添新的不確定性。儘管美方尚未公布貨幣政策措施，但相關表態可能預示，未來談判將觸及加幣升值，甚至可能衍生額外貿易限制。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday (the 6th) sharply criticized the Canadian dollar, saying the monetary "imbalance" between Canada and the United States is unacceptable, opening a new front in the escalating trade dispute between the two countries.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump said the US‑Canada currency imbalance has persisted for years and "cannot continue any longer." He did not specify what he meant by the imbalance nor reveal any actions the government might take. The remarks appear to suggest that a weaker Canadian dollar gives Canadian exporters a price advantage in the U.S. market. The Canadian dollar has recently been trading around US$0.72.

Before Trump made the comments, US‑Canada trade talks collapsed in August. Washington then imposed a 50% tariff on roughly $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, and Canada announced reciprocal tariffs of the same magnitude on equivalent U.S. products, covering steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, paper and electronics, set to take effect on September 8.

Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau stressed that any trade agreement must contain concrete guarantees that the United States will not unilaterally change tariff rules for key sectors such as automobiles, steel and aluminum. The Trump administration, however, argued that the U.S. had already offered highly favorable terms and accused Canada of making excessive demands.

Data from the Office of the United States Trade Representative show that the U.S. goods trade deficit with Canada will reach $48.3 billion in 2025, partially offset by a $27.7 billion surplus in services trade; as of July 2026, the goods deficit remains around $28.2 billion.

Trump’s shift of focus to the exchange rate adds a new layer of uncertainty to the US‑Canada trade relationship beyond tariffs. Although Washington has not yet announced any monetary‑policy measures, his statements could signal that future negotiations may address a stronger Canadian dollar and possibly lead to additional trade restrictions.

items.title: 川普特使、女婿抵達基輔 將與澤倫斯基見面
items.title_en: Trump Envoy and Son-in-Law Arrive in Kyiv for Meeting with Zelensky
paras: 美國總統特使威特科夫和川普女婿庫什納率領的美國代表團，6日（周日）乘火車抵達烏克蘭首都基輔。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基親自前往迎接，雙方握手，熱情擁抱，展現友善氣氛。這是美國總統川普第二任期以來美國總統特使首次正式訪問烏克蘭。
據《美聯社》報導，威特科夫和庫什納5日於莫斯科與俄羅斯總統普丁會面後，直接前往基輔。
川普曾表示，威特科夫和庫什納將訪問俄羅斯和烏克蘭，兩人將帶去一個「結束戰爭」的方案。
澤倫斯基6日中午在社交媒體發文，稱在美國總統特使抵達基輔前，他已召集烏克蘭談判團隊開會。烏方將一如既往，保持建設性態度，致力於推動俄烏戰事儘快結束。
澤倫斯基說，烏方需要和平，需要安全保障，也需要一份「體面戰後和平」。烏方已準備好相關提議。重要的是，要以「協調、務實且富有成效」的方式展開工作。
俄羅斯總統助理烏沙科夫6日凌晨說，普丁5日晚在克里姆林宮與威特科夫、庫什納的會面超過3個小時，內容充實，具建設性，極其坦誠，相互信任。
paras_en: U.S. presidential envoy Whitaker and Trump’s son‑in‑law Kushner led an American delegation that arrived by train in Ukraine’s capital Kyiv on Sunday, the 6th.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky personally went to greet them, shaking hands and sharing a warm embrace, creating a friendly atmosphere. This marks the first formal visit to Ukraine by a U.S. presidential envoy since Trump’s second term began.
According to the Associated Press, Whitaker and Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on the 5th before heading straight to Kyiv.
Trump had said that Whitaker and Kushner would travel to Russia and Ukraine, bringing a proposal to “end the war.”

Zelensky posted on social media at noon on the 6th that, before the U.S. envoy’s arrival in Kyiv, he had convened Ukraine’s negotiation team for a meeting. Ukraine will, as always, maintain a constructive stance and work to bring the Russia‑Ukraine conflict to a swift conclusion.

Zelensky said Ukraine needs peace, security guarantees, and a “decent post‑war peace.” Ukraine is ready with related proposals. The key is to proceed in a coordinated, pragmatic and productive manner.

Russian presidential aide Ushakov said in the early hours of the 6th that Putin’s meeting with Whitaker and Kushner at the Kremlin on the evening of the 5th lasted more than three hours, was substantive, constructive, extremely candid and built mutual trust.

items.title: 日元反轉能走多遠？高盛：結構性修復「剛啟動」、美銀預測年底升至149
paras: 日元近期漲勢強勁，短短數個交易日內升值約3%，市場焦點鎖定日本央行（BOJ）升息預期升溫，以及日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能增加國內資產配置，兩大政策因素正成為推動日元走強的主要動能。
高盛認為，這波日元升勢並非單純受到短期利差交易帶動，而是日本國內政策環境正逐步轉變。隨著市場對日本央行升息的預期升高，加上GPIF潛在的資產重新配置可能帶來持續日元買盤，過去長期壓抑日元的部分結構性因素，正逐漸轉為支撐日元的力量。
高盛因此判斷，日元長期結構性低估的修復行情可能才剛開始。
美國銀行同樣看好日元後市，認為日本央行加快升息、國內資金回流，以及政策面支撐，都可能持續為日元提供動能。若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，美元兌日元年底可能降至149。
不過，摩根大通雖然也看好日元短期表現，卻提醒市場對日本央行升息及GPIF資產重新配置的預期已反映相當程度。一旦實際政策落地程度不如預期，日元可能面臨快速回檔壓力。
因此，日元這波由日本政策轉向帶動的升勢，能否進一步發展成持續性行情。

高盛：日元強勢可能才剛開始　政策轉向成關鍵

高盛指出，目前推動日元走強的兩大主軸，分別是日本央行升息預期升溫，以及市場預期GPIF可能進一步提高國內資產配置。
其中，GPIF可能引發的資金流動尤其受到關注。高盛援引2020年的經驗指出，GPIF當年雖於3月底正式宣布調整外債配置目標，但相關資金流動早在1、2月便已出現，顯示實際資產調整可能早於政策正式公布。
因此，高盛特別關注9月7日公布的8月國際證券交易（ITS）數據，認為其中可能浮現GPIF資金輪動的早期跡象。
高盛表示，過去幾年日元持續疲弱，很大程度受到美國經濟韌性及日美利差擴大影響；如今日本央行政策方向轉變，加上GPIF可能調整國內資產配置，使日元過去面臨的結構性逆風逐漸減弱，甚至可能轉化為支撐日元的力量。

美銀：日銀轉鷹加上政策支撐　日元升勢仍有空間

美國銀行最新政策研判也認為，日元這波漲勢仍可能延續。
隨著日本央行政策立場轉向偏鷹，此前持續壓抑日元的部分因素正在逐步消退。美銀預期，日本央行可能維持每季升息的步調，目前市場已反映政策利率至2027年7月升至2%的預期。
若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，做空日元的交易邏輯可能進一步弱化。
美銀預估，美元兌日元年底將回落至149，並將155視為重要技術關卡。若匯價跌破155，日元買盤可能進一步加速。
此外，日本經濟基本面改善、升息預期升溫，以及日本投資人可能從海外債券轉向日本國債，都可能為日元提供額外支撐。
政策方面，美銀認為，日本政府扭轉日元弱勢的意願正在升高。財務省此前沒有採取激進干預，可能是希望先為日本央行加快升息創造條件。
若升息路徑更加明確、日元卻仍持續走弱，財務省可能透過買進日元進行干預。因此，即使美元受到支撐，美元兌日元的升值空間仍可能受到政策因素限制。

摩根大通：短線看多日元　但政策若不如預期恐快速回檔

相較之下，摩根大通對GPIF資產重新配置的看法更為保守。
8月31日公布的議程顯示，GPIF於8月21日召開管理委員會，這是7年來首次在8月舉行會議；此外，原本在3月得出「無需審查」結論的基本組合驗證工作，也重新進入討論。
摩根大通認為，這顯示GPIF可能正在重新檢視資產配置，不過短期更可能是在現有配置區間內進行調整，而非正式修改基本組合。
若GPIF將國內債券配置從26.91%提高至區間上限31%，理論上相當於約12.3兆日元的日元買盤；若日本股票配置從23.81%提高至31%，則相當於約21.6兆日元，兩者合計約33.8兆日元。
另一方面，摩根大通認為，市場對日本央行升息的預期已經偏高。9月升息幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，1年期1年期交換利率升至約2.13%，隱含的緊縮速度甚至高於摩根大通自身預測。
若市場對升息的預期開始降溫，日元反而可能承受壓力。

摩根大通重拾美元多頭　9月CPI成關鍵

摩根大通對美元中期走勢則持較正面的看法，認為美元相對於利率基差仍被低估約3%至4%，而美國經濟展現的韌性，也尚未充分反映在目前美元匯率中。
美國失業率目前維持在4.1%，低於聯準會（Fed）年底預測的4.3%。摩根大通預期，在聯準會今年僅升息一次的情境下，美國美元收益率仍將高於全球逾50%的貨幣，接近25年來高位；若全年升息達3次，這一比例將提高至約58%。
接下來，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將成為重要觀察指標。CPI將於9月11日公布，隨後9月16日登場聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議，以及9月17日英國央行、9月18日日本央行的政策會議，主要央行政策預期可能在短時間內密集重新定價。
摩根大通指出，聯準會內部對政策方向仍存在明顯分歧，通膨數據將進一步檢驗市場對未來貨幣政策路徑的預期。
對美元而言，後續走勢將取決於美國經濟數據及聯準會政策預期變化。若美國通膨與就業數據持續展現韌性，美元利率優勢可望獲得支撐；反之，若通膨降溫促使市場重新押注寬鬆政策，美元則可能面臨壓力。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.

items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 印尼盾有望連續第五周上漲 寫兩年來最長連漲紀錄
items.title_en: Indonesian Rupiah Poised for Fifth Consecutive Week of Gains, Setting Two-Year Longest Winning Streak
paras: 印尼盾近日表現強勁，預計將迎來連續第五周上漲，創下兩年來最長的周度連漲走勢。
印尼盾兌美元匯率在周五(4日)亞市早盤交易中報 17,628，持續徘徊在 17,650 附近，本周美元兌印尼盾預計下跌 0.4%，有望創下自 5 月 20 日以來的最低收盤價格。
此波強勢上漲主要受到內外部因素的雙重支撐。其中，外部環境改善，市場因聯準會(Fed)官員的鴿派言論，調降了本月的升息預期。美債殖利率的回落與美元的走弱，皆為印尼盾提供了顯著的短期支撐。
內部政策也有助維持穩定，印尼央行承諾維護匯率穩定。新任印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti釋放了政策延續性的訊號，強調政策以穩定為先，並透過綜合政策助力經濟成長、維持對境外投資人的吸引力。她也提到，目前國內通膨仍處於受控狀態。
然而，市場分析也指出潛在的制約因素。華僑銀行外匯策略師 Christopher Wong 提醒，高油價與持續高企的全球殖利率依舊是潛在風險。此外，聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能干擾食品供應並推高物價，加上市場在下周公布 8 月外匯存底、消費者信心和 7 月零售銷售等數據前持謹慎態度，皆可能使後續漲勢增添變數。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah has been performing strongly recently and is expected to record a fifth consecutive week of gains, marking the longest weekly rally in two years.

The rupiah’s exchange rate against the US dollar was reported at 17,628 in early Asian market trading on Friday (the 4th), hovering around the 17,650 level. This week the dollar is projected to fall 0.4% against the rupiah, potentially delivering the lowest closing price since May 20.

The robust rise is driven by a dual boost of external and internal factors. Externally, the environment has improved as Fed officials’ dovish remarks have lowered market expectations for rate hikes this month. Falling US Treasury yields and a weaker dollar have provided significant short‑term support for the rupiah.

Domestically, policy measures are helping maintain stability. The Bank of Indonesia has pledged to keep the exchange rate steady. New governor Destry Damayanti signaled policy continuity, emphasizing stability as the priority and using a comprehensive policy mix to support growth and retain foreign investor appeal. She also noted that domestic inflation remains under control.

However, analysts point to potential headwinds. OCBC’s FX strategist Christopher Wong warned that high oil prices and persistently elevated global yields remain risks. Additionally, the El Niño phenomenon could disrupt food supplies and push prices higher, and market participants are cautious ahead of next week’s releases of August foreign‑exchange reserves, consumer confidence and July retail sales data, which could add uncertainty to further gains.

items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 全球利率預期轉向 亞洲貨幣周五普遍走強
items.title_en: Global rate expectations shift, Asian currencies broadly stronger on Friday
paras: 受到聯準會官員言論影響，全球利率預期有所轉變，帶動亞洲主要貨幣在周五普遍走強。
美國聯邦準備理事會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨持續放緩，他將支持本月維持利率不變。此番言論降溫了市場對9月升息的預期，使美元面臨壓力，美元指數本周預計下跌0.7%至99.06。市場目前正密切關注即將公佈的美國8月份非農就業報告。
在此背景下，日元表現尤受矚目，有望創下自7月底以來最強勁的單周表現，本周已經升值約2.5%。
雖然美元周五兌日元午盤上漲0.3%至156.36，但日元在盤中一度強彈至155.25，逼近7月美日聯合干預時的155.2水位。市場分析指出，日元這波升值並非源於官方直接干預，而是因為市場預期日本央行(BOJ)可能在9月17至18日的會議上採取更鷹派的立場。日本央行此前已在6月將政策利率提高至1%，市場正定價9月再次升息的極高可能性。
與此同時，其他亞太貨幣也各有波動。人民幣匯率保持平穩，受弱勢美元支撐，投資人正持續評估中國私營部門服務業數據與疲軟的官方經濟背景。紐西蘭元與澳元也跟隨央行與貿易訊號波動，美元兌紐元下跌0.3%至1.70左右(紐元約合0.59美元)，紐西蘭央行此前升息25個基點至2.75%；澳洲第二季經濟成長0.4%，澳元兌美元維持在0.72美元附近。
此外，馬來西亞央行周四宣布將基準利率維持在2.75%，美元兌馬來西亞令吉在決議後微幅上漲0.16%至4.04。韓元兌美元小幅升值0.05%，至1,355.65兌1美元，而印度盧比則延續了本周的升勢。
paras_en: Influenced by comments from Federal Reserve officials, global rate expectations have shifted, driving the main Asian currencies to broadly strengthen on Friday.

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to ease, he would support keeping rates unchanged this month. His remarks cooled expectations of a September rate hike, putting pressure on the dollar, with the dollar index expected to fall 0.7% this week to 99.06. Markets are now closely watching the upcoming U.S. August non‑farm payroll report.
Against this backdrop, the yen is attracting particular attention, poised for its strongest weekly gain since the end of July, having already appreciated about 2.5% this week.

Although the dollar rose 0.3% to 156.36 per yen at midday on Friday, the yen surged intraday to 155.25, nearing the 155.2 level seen during the July US‑Japan joint intervention. Analysts note that this yen rally is not the result of direct official intervention but stems from market expectations that the Bank of Japan may adopt a more hawkish stance at its September 17‑18 meeting. The BOJ had previously lifted its policy rate to 1% in June, and markets are pricing a very high probability of another hike in September.

Meanwhile, other Asia‑Pacific currencies showed varied moves. The renminbi remained stable, supported by a weaker dollar, as investors continue to assess Chinese private‑sector services data and a soft official economic backdrop. The New Zealand dollar and Australian dollar also fluctuated on central‑bank and trade signals, with the dollar down about 0.3% to around 1.70 NZD (≈ 0.59 USD) and the RBNZ having previously raised rates by 25 basis points to 2.75%; Australia’s Q2 growth was 0.4%, keeping the Aussie near 0.72 USD.

In addition, Malaysia’s central bank announced on Thursday that it would keep its benchmark rate at 2.75%, with the dollar edging up 0.16% to 4.04 Malaysian ringgit after the decision. The Korean won modestly appreciated 0.05% to 1,355.65 per dollar, while the Indian rupee continued its upward trend for the week.

items.title: 17兆日元空單緊張！日元升破155恐引爆踩踏 匯率直奔142區間
items.title_en: 17 Trillion Yen Short Positions Tighten as Yen Surpasses 155 Threatens a Crash, Currency Heads Straight to 142 Range
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 策略師指出，若日元匯率升破155日元兌1美元的關鍵防線，規模龐大的日元空頭部位進一步回補，可能加速日元漲勢。
Junya Tanase等策略師在研究報告中寫道：「近期價格走勢似乎印證我們的看法，即市場可能仍持有相對龐大的日元空頭部位。」若美元兌日元跌破155，「不能排除賣壓引發更多賣盤，推動日元升幅超出預期的風險。」
摩根大通估計，目前市場尚未平倉的看空日元部位約達16兆至17兆日元（約1,026億美元），若這些部位全面回補，理論上可能將美元兌日元推低至142至146區間。
這項警告發布之際，日元剛經歷自7月底日本與美國聯手干預匯市以來最猛烈的漲勢之一。美元兌日元本周稍早一度升至160.39，創該次干預以來最高，隨後急遽反轉，最低跌至155.30，距離干預後低點155.23僅一步之遙。
這波強勁漲勢主要受到市場揣測日本國家退休金基金（GPIF）可能調整資產配置，以及日本央行將加快升息步伐的預期升溫所帶動。
市場觀察人士指出，投機性日元空單回補與日本國內投資人的避險需求，進一步放大這些利多因素，也提高日元續漲迫使更多空頭部位平倉的風險。
不過，摩根大通認為，市場對GPIF與日本央行的預期「似乎有些過度」，現階段並不認為美元兌日元大幅跌破其預估的155至165區間具有很高機率。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase analysts noted that if the yen breaks the critical 155 yen per dollar barrier, the massive short positions could be further closed, potentially accelerating the yen’s rise.

Junya Tanase and other strategists wrote in a research note that recent price action seems to confirm their view that the market may still hold a relatively large short yen position; if the dollar falls below 155 yen, "selling pressure could trigger more sales, pushing the yen higher than expected."

JPMorgan estimates that the market still has about 16 to 17 trillion yen (roughly $102.6 billion) of short yen positions open; if these are fully closed, the dollar could be pushed into the 142‑146 yen range.

At the time of this warning, the yen had just experienced one of the strongest rallies since the joint intervention by Japan and the United States at the end of July. The dollar‑yen pair briefly touched 160.39 earlier this week, the highest since the intervention, before sharply reversing and falling to a low of 155.30, just one point above the post‑intervention trough of 155.23.

The strong rally was mainly driven by market speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) might adjust its asset allocation, coupled with expectations that the Bank of Japan would accelerate its rate‑hike pace.

Market observers pointed out that speculative short yen positions and domestic Japanese investors’ hedging demand further amplified these positive factors, increasing the risk that the yen’s continued rise would force more shorts to close.

However, JPMorgan believes that expectations around GPIF and the Bank of Japan are "seemingly somewhat over‑stretched," and at present does not see a high probability of the dollar‑yen falling sharply below the 155‑165 range it estimated.
